executive_summary: Maven build failed with 45 compilation errors due to missing critical dependencies. The project requires Spring Security, Spring Data JPA, Jakarta Persistence, and Apache Commons Lang libraries that are not declared in pom.xml. All errors are dependency-related and can be resolved by adding the missing dependencies to the Maven configuration.

errors.message: Spring Security packages not found (web.builders, web.configuration, config.http, security.web)
errors.root_cause: Spring Security dependency is missing from pom.xml. The SecurityConfig class requires Spring Security libraries to compile.

errors.message: Spring Data JPA packages not found (data.domain, data.jpa.repository, repository.query)
errors.root_cause: Spring Data JPA dependency is missing from pom.xml. Repository interfaces and domain classes require Spring Data JPA libraries.
Jakarta Persistence API is missing. Entity classes require JPA annotations (@Entity, @Table, @Id, @Column) which are part of jakarta.persistence package.
errors.fix_recommendation: Jakarta Persistence is typically included with spring-boot-starter-data-jpa. Ensure spring-boot-starter-data-jpa dependency is added to pom.xml.

errors.message: Apache Commons Lang3 package not found
errors.root_cause: Apache Commons Lang3 dependency is missing from pom.xml. ValidationUtils class uses StringUtils or other utilities from this library.
